target: Shared Significant Hobbies product landing template

contract.purpose: Help a visitor decide whether one Significant Hobbies app fits them, see real product evidence, understand its privacy boundary, and reach the honest install path.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Anchor helps a person plan a realistic day, follow the current intention, and learn why the day lived differed from the day planned.
contract.audience: A person moving between Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch who wants a deliberate day rather than another task list.
contract.job: Understand Anchor's plan, focus, interruption, and review loop; verify its privacy promise; and check the truthful beta path.
contract.thesis: A quiet editorial sketchbook makes Anchor's real plan-to-review loop feel authored without competing with product proof.
contract.system: Dark paper and charcoal fields, cobalt focus actions, cyan annotations, real native captures, rounded display type, fine rules, and one hand-drawn planning scene.
contract.signature: A day-planning doodle frames the real Anchor screen, then the page follows the same plan, focus, capture, and history sequence as the app.
contract.risk: The long proof sequence can become repetitive on mobile, so captions and a visible first-viewport product screen must carry recognition without relying on decoration.

projectCheck.note: All eight products build with 0 Astro errors or warnings and pass 12 required public-surface checks. Fresh Anchor renders at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels show the real Today day plan in the hero and the Plan to Focus to Capture to History sequence; browser measurements found zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors at all three widths.

findings: Static detector: 0 findings; runtime palette, eyebrow, heading-size, repeated-kicker, quote-leading, glow, and grid warnings were reviewed as advisory design-context findings.
Residual P2: the mobile proof sequence remains long and repeats Focus, Capture, and History after the captioned gallery.

comprehension.reviewer: Independent fresh-visitor review by Parfit, cross-checked against Harvey's browser measurements

answers.product: Anchor is a private day planner and focus timer for Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch.
answers.audience: It is for someone who wants to plan a deliberate day across Apple devices and understand why reality diverged.
answers.value: It protects the current intention while preserving useful, non-moralizing evidence about interruptions and plan changes.
answers.mechanism: The page demonstrates the loop from planning to focus, interruption capture, and planned-versus-lived History.
answers.proof: Real Anchor captures, explicit privacy copy, fit boundaries, and honest beta status substantiate the claims.
answers.nextAction: Use See TestFlight status to check the gated beta path without implying a public build exists.

ownerFeedback.note: The operator explicitly approved pushing and releasing the completed work on 28 August 2026.
